title: The long corridor
goals: Reach the door at the end.
Do it in fewer than 2 lines.
starting_code:
# Tell the method how many steps to take
wizard.move_right()
hints: Count the tiles to the door.
Put the number of steps between the brackets.
You need to walk six steps to the right.
intro: This path is very long. We can tell an action how much to do. Put a number inside the brackets.
outro: You saved so much time! That door looks interesting.
learned: Now you know that a number, which programmers call an argument, tells a method how much to do.
